semantics.mechanism: A fixed weekday directional bias, entered at that day's first bar. Pure calendar effect; in-sample-favourable, multiple-testing across weekdays acknowledged (calendar families are overfit-prone).
semantics.signal_reason: At the first bar of the chosen weekday, enter next open directionally; hold.

entry.description: First bar of a UTC Thursday.
